title: Hands-on Exercise 1
text:
1.6 Geoprocessing with sf package

1.6.1 Use case 1: Land acquisition analysis

buffer_cycling <- st_buffer(cyclingpath, dist = 5, nQuadSegs = 30)
buffer_cycling <- buffer_cycling %>%
  mutate(
    AREA = st_area(st_geometry(buffer_cycling))
  )
sum(buffer_cycling$AREA)

5317952 [m^2]



mpsz_selected <- mpsz %>%
  filter(SUBZONE_N == "TAMPINES WEST")
buffer_cycling <- st_transform(buffer_cycling, crs = 3414)
mpsz_selected <- st_transform(mpsz_selected, crs = 3414)

buffer_cycling_selected <- st_intersection(buffer_cycling, mpsz_selected)
plot(st_geometry(mpsz_selected))
plot(st_geometry(buffer_cycling_selected), add = TRUE)

popdata <- read_csv("hands-on_ex1_data/respopagesextod2024.csv")

popdata2024 <- popdata %>%
  group_by(PA, SZ, AG) %>%
  summarise(`POP` = sum(`Pop`)) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=AG, 
              values_from=POP) %>%
  mutate(YOUNG = rowSums(.[3:6])
         +rowSums(.[12])) %>%
mutate(`ECONOMY ACTIVE` = rowSums(.[7:11])+
rowSums(.[13:15]))%>%
mutate(`AGED`=rowSums(.[16:21])) %>%
mutate(`TOTAL`=rowSums(.[3:21])) %>%  
mutate(`DEPENDENCY` = (`YOUNG` + `AGED`)
/`ECONOMY ACTIVE`) %>%
  select(`PA`, `SZ`, `YOUNG`, 
       `ECONOMY ACTIVE`, `AGED`, 
       `TOTAL`, `DEPENDENCY`)

popdata2024 <- popdata2024 %>%
  mutate_at(.vars = vars(PA, SZ), 
          .funs = list(toupper)) %>%
  filter(`ECONOMY ACTIVE` > 0)

mpsz_pop2024 <- left_join(mpsz2, popdata2024,
                          by = c("SUBZONE_N" = "SZ"))

write_rds(mpsz_pop2024, "hands-on_ex1_data/mpsz_pop2024.rds")
